name: Skyline Flight Tracker
description: A local flight tracker with bundled photographic maps and public ADSB.lol positions. No account or hosting required.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; connect-src https://api.adsb.lol; img-src 'self' data: https://gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov https://basemap.nationalmap.gov; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'; form-action 'none'
